recognize_zh: 骨小樑旁的髓腔被成片、粉紅色細胞質豐富的類上皮組織球（epithelioid histiocytes）與淋巴球取代，看不到脂肪與正常三系造血，符合骨髓肉芽腫性發炎。
features: Marrow space effaced by a sheet-like, poorly circumscribed aggregate of cells with abundant eosinophilic cytoplasm
Cells with elongated to oval, pale nuclei consistent with epithelioid histiocytes, admixed with small lymphocytes
Vague nodular (confluent granuloma) architecture in the upper field
Absence of adipocytes and recognizable normal hematopoiesis in this field
No definite caseous necrosis or multinucleated giant cells at this magnification; adjacent bony trabecula
describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy at low-to-medium power shows the intertrabecular space replaced by a confluent, poorly circumscribed infiltrate of epithelioid histiocytes with abundant eosinophilic cytoplasm and oval nuclei, admixed with small lymphocytes. Adipocytes and normal trilineage hematopoiesis are not seen in this field. Definite caseous necrosis and Langhans giant cells are not appreciated at this magnification. Findings are consistent with granulomatous inflammation; special stains for acid-fast bacilli and fungi and cultures are recommended.

ddx.dx: Classic Hodgkin lymphoma with granulomatous reaction
ddx.vs: Contains scattered large CD30+/CD15+ Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg cells within the histiocyte-rich infiltrate.
Spindle-shaped mast cell aggregates can mimic epithelioid histiocytes but are CD117 and tryptase positive with aberrant CD25.
Tumor cells are cohesive with nuclear atypia and keratin positivity, while epithelioid histiocytes are CD68/CD163 positive.
Small, incidental lesions with lipid vacuoles, usually near lymphoid aggregates, rather than a large confluent infiltrate.
